items.difficulty_reason: 4 行、有界复与完美性：对非零上同调个数归纳；典范截断三角把 K 拆成更短复（归纳假设完美）与最高次上同调（假设完美）；two-out-of-three 引理合成出 K 完美。承重（截断三角、two-out-of-three）都在 span 内；1 处引用作导航桩。

proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: induct on the length of the bounded complex, cutting off the last cohomology with a canonical truncation triangle and closing the induction with the two-out-of-three property of perfect objects (source lines 18992-18996)
